opportunities.name: Company account brief email (SEC + Wikipedia)
opportunities.description: For a given ticker, look up the latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, get HQ/employees/CEO from Wikipedia, and draft an account brief email to dana@example.com.
steps: Search ticker on SEC EDGAR and select the company
Click Form filter and open the 10-K annual report to get filing date
Search company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Read HQ, employee count and CEO from the infobox
Compose email To dana@example.com with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body with HQ, employees, CEO and latest 10-K date
Discard/send

instances.values: HUBS (SEC 10-K lookup, brief not seen completed)

opportunities.name: Supplier quote comparison email (currency + local time)
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier amounts from two currencies to USD on xe.com, check the supplier's city local time on timeanddate, and email procurement the comparison.
steps: Open Xe currency converter
Enter amount and select source currency, target USD, click Convert, note result
Repeat for second amount and currency
Search supplier city on timeanddate World Clock and read local time
Compose email to procurement@example.com with subject 'Quotes: <item>'
Type body with both conversions, cheaper option and supplier local time
Discard/send

instances.values: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka, CNC enclosures
8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Shipping boxes

opportunities.name: Timezone difference and holidays sync email
opportunities.description: Compare two cities on timeanddate time zone converter, look up holidays for a country/month, and email ops with the time offset and dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zone Converter
Add city A and city B
Read time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays, pick country and month
Note holiday dates
Compose email to ops@example.com with subject 'Sync: A / B, Month'
Type body with offset and dates to avoid
Discard/send
